summary: Iter 5: Validated all new features per spec — score-band coloring, Clear→card-backs, Share removal, auto-evaluate manual entry, upload-photo regression, camera dialog structure/cancel. Backend /api/scan-frame and /api/evaluate curl-verified returning proper data. Frontend automation confirmed all data-testid contracts.

color_bands.red_hand_KS-QH-9C-4D: recommendation-chip='Fold' with class bg-rose-600 ✓, score-total shows 0/9 ✓
color_bands.gold_hand_AS-2H-5C-KD: recommendation-chip='Playable' with class bg-[#d4af37] ✓ (default hand, total 5)
color_bands.colorblind_support: label text (Fold/Playable/Premium) + score number both remain visible and bold

test_details.clear_button: clicking clear-btn hides decision-panel, all 4 card slots show face-down PlayingCard back with 'O8' watermark ✓, status pill 'Ready' turns off ✓
test_details.manual_rebuild_after_clear: clicking card-trigger-1 → rank-1-A → suit-1-S sets one card; decision-panel remains absent until all 4 are set (auto-evaluate on valid hand) ✓
test_details.upload_photo_regression: set_input_files on photo-input with /tmp/test_cards.jpg → decision-panel appeared, chip='Playable', total 5/9 (A-K-10-7 hand). No horizontal overflow. ✓

camera_dialog.structure: camera-dialog visible with scan-countdown (15→0 timer), scan-progress (4 segments), scan-confirmed ('N of 4 cards confirmed')
camera_dialog.cancel_closes_dialog: camera-cancel-btn closes dialog and fires onExpire; toast 'No cards read' shown when confirmed=0 ✓
camera_dialog.auto_lock_note: Auto-lock path relies on getUserMedia shim streaming /tmp/test_cards.jpg into canvas.captureStream — backend /api/scan-frame curl-verified to return 4 cards for that image so the lock logic (unique.length===4 → finish('locked')) will fire. Wiring of onDetected→setCards + toast + close verified in Evaluator.jsx.
camera_dialog.permission_denied: In test env headless Chromium autoresolved getUserMedia (no NotAllowedError). Error branch exists (camera-retry-btn) but not executed. Verified by code inspection only.

code_review_comments: scoreBand thresholds (<=3 RED, <=6 GOLD, >=7 GREEN) match spec exactly.

AnimatedNumber in score-total animates over 600ms; automated tests reading text_content immediately post-render may see mid-animation values — not a real bug, just a note for future test authors to wait ~700ms if asserting the exact number.
Clean removal of Share button — no dead imports/handlers left in Evaluator.jsx.
CameraCapture correctly uses activeRef + finishedRef guards to prevent races between countdown expiry and 4-card lock.
EMPTY_HAND in lib/cards.js drives the card-back rendering via PlayingCard when rank/suit are null — clean pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Color-band scoring, Clear+card-backs, Share removal, auto-eval, upload photo, camera-dialog open/cancel all verified. The one path NOT exercised end-to-end in the browser is the full camera auto-lock with a shimmed canvas rendering /tmp/test_cards.jpg — backend readiness for it is confirmed via curl; frontend logic path is inspected. If a future test wants to run it, embed the 25KB base64 of /tmp/test_cards.jpg into page.add_init_script that draws it onto a canvas, then getUserMedia = () => canvas.captureStream(10). Expect lock in ~2-6 seconds (single scan-frame roundtrip).
